correctness.rationale: Every apex is the unique off-base extreme point; different cone directions have different apexes. Affine base functionals isolate apexes and imply affine independence. With fewer than n+1 apices, any residual extreme point belongs to every base hyperplane; its translations make the k normals independent. The common section has dimension n-k, giving a full-dimensional k-fold pyramid. Counts k=n or k=n-1 would force a simplex, contradiction, while simplices have n+1. Exact cross-polytope pyramids realize 0,...,n-2. All steps are proved for arbitrary compact full-dimensional convex bodies; 35 exact-rank tests are supplemental finite checks only.
